title: Urban Contemplation
coreRelationships: The woman's figure is centrally anchored by the light pole, creating a vertical axis.
The large blue heart in the foreground acts as a visual counterpoint to the woman, balancing the lower left.
The soft, diffused light from the right illuminates the woman and the street, creating depth.
The blurred cityscape and sky provide a sense of place while keeping focus on the subject.
The woman's gaze directs the viewer's eye towards the distant, bright cityscape.
